5.name: Thyme Bundle
5.why: Thyme tied in a bunch and hung to dry under the kitchen beams is this green, gone a little dim with keeping.

5.name: Hedgerow
5.why: A late-summer hedge, dark and faintly yellow where the light gets through the leaves.

5.name: Nettle Cloth
5.why: Cloth spun by hand from nettle stems, a green that once stung and now keeps you warm.

6.name: Morning Dew
6.why: The pale green a garden wears before the sun has had time to dry it.

6.name: Willow Mist
6.why: Willow leaves seen through early mist, quiet and a little silvered.

6.name: Moonwort
6.why: An old herbal's silver-green fern, the one that grows only where the moon has been.
